stories.title: Italian GP Weekend Opens — Antonelli Starts From Back as Norris Eyes Three Straight

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
🏁 IT'S MONZA WEEKEND.

FP1 starts in hours. Here's your Italian GP storyline card:

🔴 Antonelli: championship leader, starting LAST
🟠 Norris: two wins in a row, heavy favourite
🐎 Ferrari: Schumacher tribute livery. The Tifosi are ready.

Let's go. #ItalianGP #F1

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Kimi Antonelli leads the F1 championship by 59 points.

This weekend at Monza — his HOME RACE — he starts from the back of the grid.

That's the story of the 2026 Italian Grand Prix. 🎢 #ItalianGP #F1

facebook.image_caption: Monza weekend is here. Antonelli starts from the back. Norris chases three straight wins. Ferrari honors Schumacher. This Italian GP has EVERYTHING. 🏁 #F1 #ItalianGP

stories.title: Ferrari Pays Stunning Schumacher Tribute at Monza — Special Livery, Barrichello and Vettel to Drive

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Ferrari's Schumacher tribute at Monza is absolutely breathtaking. 🔴

Glossy red livery. White rear wing. Gold wheels. MS logo on the car.

Hamilton and Leclerc wear Schumacher-inspired race suits.

30 years since he joined Ferrari. 20 since his last season. #F1 #ItalianGP

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Rubens Barrichello will drive a Schumacher-era Ferrari at Monza this weekend.

Then Sebastian Vettel takes over for a demonstration lap before Sunday's race.

This is going to be EMOTIONAL. 🙏 #F1 #ItalianGP #Schumacher

stories.title: F1 Season Finale in Doubt — Qatar and Abu Dhabi at Risk Due to Middle East Conflict

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
The 2026 F1 season finale is in doubt.

Qatar (Nov 27-29) and Abu Dhabi (Dec 4-6) may be cancelled due to ongoing Middle East conflict. F1 has until mid-September to decide.

If they go: season ends in Europe. Imola is the leading candidate. #F1

facebook.image_caption: The 2026 F1 season finale may not happen in Qatar or Abu Dhabi. Middle East conflict has FOM considering European alternatives — with Imola as the frontrunner. 🌍 #F1

stories.title: Antonelli's Engine Gamble — Can Mercedes' 20-Year-Old Champion Recover From the Back?

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Here's WHY Kimi Antonelli is starting from the back at Monza.

He exceeded the limit on 4 power unit components — ICE, exhaust, energy store, control electronics.

Mercedes chose Monza deliberately: best overtaking circuit on the calendar. #F1 #ItalianGP

facebook.image_caption: Kimi Antonelli knows this weekend is going to be tough. But Mercedes chose Monza for his engine penalty deliberately — highest recovery potential in F1. Can he do it? #F1 #ItalianGP
